record.paper_title: Open problems in dynamics and related fields
record.original_question: Let A be the group of all diagonal matrices in SL(3,R). Is every bounded A-orbit in SL(3,R)/SL(3,Z) closed?

evidence.quote: CONJECTURE 39 (G. Margulis [174]) . Let A be the group of all diagonal matrices in SL(3, R). Then every bounded A-orbit in SL(3, R)/SL(3, Z) is closed.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})$, let $\Gamma=\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{Z})$, and consider the homogeneous space $G/\Gamma$ with its quotient topology. Let
\[
A=\{\,\mathrm{diag}(a_1,a_2,a_3) : a_i\in\mathbb{R},\ a_i>0\ \text{or treated more generally as real diagonal entries with}\ a_1a_2a_3=1\,\}
\]
denote the full group of diagonal matrices of determinant $1$ in $G$, acting on $G/\Gamma$ by left translation. An $A$-orbit $A\cdot x\subset G/\Gamma$ is called bounded (relatively compact) if its closure in $G/\Gamma$ is compact, and closed if $A\cdot x$ is a closed subset of $G/\Gamma$.

Prove or disprove: every bounded $A$-orbit in $G/\Gamma$ is closed.
artifact.status_search_result: This is a well-known conjecture of G. Margulis (equivalent in the $n=3$ case to a problem of Cassels and Swinnerton-Dyer) that every bounded orbit of the full diagonal group on $\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{R})/\mathrm{SL}(3,\mathbb{Z})$ is closed (equivalently, compact). It remains open. Surveys and recent work (e.g., An–Guan on bounded orbits in homogeneous dynamics, and 2024–2025 papers on bounded diagonal orbits) treat it as an outstanding conjecture; partial results include Schmidt-game-style abundance theorems for bounded orbits but not the conjecture itself.

status_evidence.title: Bounded Orbits of Homogeneous Dynamics (An–Guan)
status_evidence.snippet: Margulis conjectured that if n ≥ 3, then every bounded A-orbit in X_n is compact.
status_evidence.claim: States the conjecture as an open problem in current surveys.

status_evidence.title: Modified Schmidt Games and a Conjecture of Margulis (Weiss)
status_evidence.snippet: Conjecture of G.A. Margulis on the abundance of certain exceptional orbits...
status_evidence.claim: Resolves an abundance conjecture of Margulis, distinct from the bounded-orbits-are-closed conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Bounded diagonal orbits in homogeneous spaces over function fields
status_evidence.snippet: Bounded diagonal orbits in homogeneous spaces over function fields (2025).
status_evidence.claim: Recent work in 2025 still motivated by Margulis's bounded-orbit conjecture, indicating it is open.
